responseScenarios: 200 HTML: cleanup + pagination; no CAPTCHA API/network calls; injected JavaScript parses
429 to 200: Surge policy retry + cleanup + pagination; numeric status 200
429 remains 429: unchanged response; no cleanup or pagination injected
Surge status 429 overrides legacy statusCode 200; no false successful HTML injection
Missing Surge status: never assumes success
CAPTCHA timeout: unchanged response; one final completion
503 to JSON 200: preserves retry response without HTML injection
limitations: Node VM 模拟 Surge API；未在真实 iPhone Surge 内执行网络重写。
自动翻页验证注入和脚本语法；未验证 Google 当前页面 DOM 与滚动行为。
微信短链保持原目标；没有逐个启动微信小程序。
